articles.title: Kalshi June trading volume tops $9B as World Cup fuels prediction markets
articles.snippet: Kalshi posted a record month for trading volume as the expanded FIFA World Cup boosted prediction market activity, DefiLlama data shows.

articles.title: Treasury Department Sanctions Over 130 ISIS-Affiliated Crypto Wallets on Tron
articles.snippet: More than 130 Tron wallets connected with a Central Asian ISIS affiliate were sanctioned by the U.S. government, with funds frozen by Tether.
